scope:
Chromium -> actual app HTTP -> rediscovered Piper -> real Vietnamese ONNX -> FFmpeg MP4.
Only AI text and illustration HTTP are fixtures. Windows-native acceptance is separate.
Requires AIOS_QA_PIPER_ASSETS (pinned model+JSON), AIOS_QA_PYTHON_PATH (installed piper),
and optional AIOS_QA_CHROMIUM. No downloads, live AI account or publishing in this script.
illustrations: local HTTP fixture, not neural image generation

checks.name: Fresh refresh distinguishes actual FFmpeg from incomplete voice installation; unauthenticated refresh rejected
Real client-order click fails before AI when voice is incomplete; failure receipt shown

Final MP4 decodes, contains non-silent neural Vietnamese speech, illustration frames and downloadable source assets
Duplicate recovery click/reload is idempotent and does not create a second run
Transient real-process failure retries the SAME existing run; approved script/reviewer are reused; no duplicate AI work
